verdict_reason: All five gates are supported by code and by tests the Lead executed, and the six findings from the first WSL read-only review (including BLOCKER F1) are fixed and covered by tests. G2-E nevertheless remains PARTIAL: its second conjunct requires an independent read-only auditor to review the ACTUAL WSL repository files, and no auditor session available to this Lead can read that path. The Lead's subagents run in the Windows opencode.exe domain rooted at Desktop\PA4 and receive permission.rejected: external_directory for every WSL path. A reviewer DID gain access in the user's own WSL session and produced the F1-F6 findings; a second such session is required to re-check the fixes.
defects_fixed: torchrl Binary is int8 while the env emits bool; boolean leaves use Unbounded(dtype=torch.bool) so the spec matches truthful data (check_env_specs had failed on dtype mismatch)
nested players Composite required the full [N,2] shape, not [2]
independent oracle re-derived its seed after episode_id incremented, replaying the wrong episode; now records used_seed/used_teams
partial reset used reset_batch, invalidating untouched handles; now uses reset_slots_batch on masked slots only
truncation was counted as a completed match (guard was 'term or trunc'); completion now requires term, truncation tracked separately with no payout (found by read-only review)
limitations: G2-E second conjunct unmet: no auditor session available to this Lead could read the WSL repo; the F1-F6 fixes are therefore not independently re-reviewed
Four seeded games only; exactly the G2-B minimum
The oracle is a second native engine but shares the PA4 decoder path, so decoder bugs are invisible to it
CPU native stepping only; no GPU simulation or throughput claim
Max observed legal candidates 18 is an inherited fixture bound, not a global maximum
P1 policy is randomly initialised (seed 20261006); no strength claim
No benchmark or performance optimisation performed
P1 replay still needs the original observation payload
PA3 pin is the public main tip, not verified live production state
The P2 execution prompt named in the task does not exist on this machine; PA4-P2-DESIGN-v1.0 was used as the authority
test_commands: uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests/environment -t .
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests/action_distribution -t .
notes: One step per native advance attempt; never one step per branch choice and never one step per match.
match_completed is emitted at most once per naturally terminated episode; truncated episodes are not counted as matches.
player_view(seat) is the only policy-facing extraction and returns that seat's own observation only.
No P3 collector, PPO, profiling or cloud work was performed.
The P2 execution prompt file named in the task does not exist on this machine; work followed PA4-P2-DESIGN-v1.0, which is the authoritative design.

review_findings_status.F1_BLOCKER_p1_packet_never_crossed_env: FIXED - test_p1_integration.py now calls ConditionalPolicy.complete_request for each requesting seat, replays the record to prove it is genuine, asserts an actor_active row exists, and a second test plays a whole battle with P1 policy decisions on both seats
review_findings_status.F2_no_slot_generation_episode_identity: FIXED - packets carry action_episode_id and action_native_generation; _step rejects mismatches and rejects any submission after the episode concluded
review_findings_status.F3_branch_count_not_compared: FIXED - supplied prefix length must equal the native branch count; extra actions on a Wait/Finished seat raise; each row is checked against native candidates
review_findings_status.F4_revision_conflated_with_invalid: FIXED - illegal packets raise before submission; a genuine accepted=False is counted in SlotState.revisions
review_findings_status.F5_metrics_were_prose: FIXED - test_measured_evidence.py measures illegal_submissions, Replacement/Wait observation, one completion per episode, and adds explicit rejection tests

harness_bug_found_and_fixed: The Lead's own measurement harness seeded the action RNG from the step index only, so all four 'distinct seeds' played an identical action sequence (identical 12-step games, all winner 1). Seeding now includes env._seed; the four games are genuinely distinct (20/11/19/14 steps, winners 0/1/0/1).
p1_code_change: PA3 refuses to resolve token refs for non-PICK actions without the player-known active->roster map, so build_branch_table and ConditionalPolicy now accept and thread observation.active_to_roster(). P1 had only ever exercised PICK actions. P1 regression remains 39/39 green.
p1_action_packet_evidence: Two tests: a single-step packet generated by ConditionalPolicy and verified by replay, and a full battle driven end-to-end by ConditionalPolicy on both seats
auditor_who_could_read: A review DID run with access in the user's own WSL opencode session and produced the F1-F6 findings at commit 67f1d59. It was not available to this Lead session.
